integrity: The path-count identity, recurrence, coefficient inequalities and root comparison constitute an analytic proof; finite computation is separately reported as corroboration, not certification. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact results are for full integer-branch maps and alternation of a single length-two cylinder at each temporal phase; neither arbitrary moving holes nor general Markov shifts are covered. The nearest full-text comparisons do not exclude all unknown equivalent formulations.
title: Exact phase-sensitive survival laws for alternating length-two Markov holes
